registry_patch.wiki_article: EA-CORPORA-43 is the forty-third seating of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's originals shelf, prepared under Rebekah Cranes, the standing authority on the EA-CORPORA deposits, on 22 November 2026, for the working collation EA-IPRH-01 on the inferential provenance of the Riemann result. Its four seats hold the primary record of the Alpöge–Claude proof: Levent Alpöge's announcement with the twenty-step timeline that, by his own footnote, Claude provided (43/01); the exposition written by Claude Fable 5.2, Codex Astra 6.2 and Gemini Carbon at the behest of Michael O. Rubinstein, whose byline records a three-model configuration (43/02); the Lean archive pinned by SHA-256 9631b4f0…, the CocoSgt mirror's commits and the tree of its 175,192 entries, without its files (43/03); and dated snapshots of the verification and reading pages of Andrew Sutherland, Michael Rubinstein, the independent GRH Lean check and the Riemann Proof Atlas (43/04). No publisher declares a licence; the files are held as published, exempt from the archive's CC BY 4.0, carrying the status none declared. The body declares what is not seated and why.
